 Tottenham Hotspur have made significant changes to their starting lineup for their Premier League meeting with Ipswich Town on November 21, 2026. Manager Roberto De Zerbi has selected Luca Williams-Barnett for his first full senior appearance, while several established players return to the starting team for the 3 p.m. kickoff.
 According to Tottenham's official team announcement, the starting selection features changes following the club's narrow defeat against Leeds United before the international break. Williams-Barnett's inclusion is a notable development, with the young player receiving an opportunity to make his mark at senior level.

 Marcos, Senesi, Conor Gallagher, James Maddison, Destiny Udogie, Dominic Solanke and Williams-Barnett are among the players named in the starting selection. The club confirmed that six changes have been made compared with the previous starting lineup.
 Also Read 
 De Zerbi Weighs Williams-Barnett Start Against Ipswich 
 Tottenham's confirmed starting XI consists of Kinsky, Senesi, van Hecke, Gallagher, Maddison, Udogie, Fernandes, Solanke, Kudus, Pedro Porro and Williams-Barnett. Porro will captain the team against Ipswich.
 The home side also have several experienced options available from the substitutes' bench. Dubravka, Andy Robertson, Archie Gray, Bergvall, Savio, Kulusevski, Marmoush, Bentancur and van de Ven are included among the replacements.
 Ipswich Town have also confirmed their selection for the Premier League fixture. The visitors will be looking to challenge Tottenham with a starting formation featuring Walton in goal and O'Shea wearing the captain's armband.
 Also Read 
 Tottenham Weighs Williams-Barnett First-Team Role Amid Injuries 
 Ipswich's starting XI includes Walton, Furlong, Davis, Diop, Flemming, Enciso, Lukic, Palacios, O'Shea, Maeda and Outtara. The selection provides the visitors with their confirmed personnel for the trip to face Tottenham.
 The away team's substitutes are Scherpen, Matusiwa, Fatawu, Philogene, Florentino, Emersonn, Greaves, Akpom and Clarke. Ipswich therefore have nine replacement players named for the contest.
 Tottenham's lineup announcement confirms Williams-Barnett's first full senior start and the return of several players to the starting team. Both clubs have now published their selections ahead of the scheduled 3 p.m. Premier League kickoff.
